**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** The code of this slice is good and its tests pass. Two items block it:
1. The PR does not merge with `main`. The conflict is in shared logic.
2. The PR changes the UI and the body has no before/after screenshots.

Ownership record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4280#issuecomment-7208671906

## Scope

This PR holds the commits of #4233 and #4271. Neither parent has a collaborator review yet. This review reads and tests the three commits of this slice (`8edfca4bd..5300e9187`). The parent commits get their own reviews. The conflict notes below also touch parent code, because the refresh must resolve it.

Safety tier: no. The slice adds catalogue data and a UI group. It does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry code. The collet adds no length and no body, so the derived gauge length and holder body of a chuck stack do not change. I ran two mutations anyway (below).

## What looks good

- The collets use the one ER table that exists (`holder_library::ER_SIZES`). The existing fit rule gives the pairs. No new rule is necessary.
- The swap list keeps only the stacks that `ta::derive` resolves. The resolver checks each fit (`check_links` -> `check_fit`), so a swap cannot offer a part that does not fit.
- A swap lands as one `SetToolAssembly` (one undo step). It is off when the stack has edits that are not applied. Undo restores the tool record.
- `stack_view` caches on (tool, document version, links). A still frame builds nothing, and a test pins this.
- The refusal of the resolver shows by name. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in non-test code. Provenance lines are present. All files are below 400 lines.
- The new app tests join the `tool_library_holders` directory suite. The UI tests are in the `camcraft-ui` lib. The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes up by 5.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3898-tool-library-components-2.md` records the choices and the dropped options.

## Results (locally, macOS, PR head 5300e9187, not merged with main: see finding 1)

- Quick gate `cargo xtask gate quick --base 8edfca4bd` (this slice): 13 steps, 0 failed.
  - app lib: 318 passed.
  - app `tool_library_holders`: 28 passed.
  - ui lib: 1725 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
  - ui suites `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool`: all pass.
- Pinning tests by name: the 3 `builtin_collets::*` tests and the 5 `tool_library_stack::*` tests pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run: the quick plan against the merge base with `main` (365 steps, because `schema.rs` changed in #4233). It belongs to the review of the parent and to the refreshed head.

Extra suites run: none were due. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

## Mutations (each one restored after the run)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `stack_view.rs` `swaps_at`: offer each candidate, also when the stack does not resolve | red: `a_swap_offers_only_parts_that_resolve_and_is_one_undo_step` (line 111) |
| `component_library.rs` `builtin_collets`: stop one millimetre before `max_bore` | red: `each_er_series_has_a_collet_for_each_whole_millimetre`, `a_built_in_er_chuck_takes_its_collets_and_a_collet_takes_its_shank` |

## Requested before merge

1. **The PR conflicts with `main` in shared logic.** A trial merge with `upstream/main` (`afca9b8b1`) stops in three files. `main` merged #3646 (multi-seat cutters), which changed the same types:
   - `crates/app/src/schema.rs`: `DocumentComponent` gets `milling` and `running` on `main`, and `library_ref` here. Keep all three fields. Use `DocumentComponent::new` from `main` where possible.
   - `crates/app/src/commands/tool_assembly.rs`: `UpsertDocumentComponent::with_row` and `EditDocumentComponent::new` / `with_row` changed on the two sides. The edit must keep the held `library_ref` (#3645) and also the held `milling` and `running` (#3646). `with_row` must keep `row_law` from `main`. Decide one visibility (`pub` on `main`, `pub(crate)` here).
   - `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders.rs`: keep the modules of the two sides (`multi_seat`, `component_files`, `component_sync`, `builtin_collets`) and the two doc lines.
   - Also after the merge: each struct literal `DocumentComponent { component, geometry, library_ref }` stops compiling. One is in this slice: `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders/builtin_collets.rs:152`.
   - Data-loss risk: `main` does not save `milling` and `running` in the project file. `component_wire.rs` (from #4233) adds the save of the component table. After the merge it must also write and read `milling` and `running`, with a round-trip test. If it does not, save and open drop the facts of a multi-seat body and an insert's running data.
   - The stack order stays: #4233 merges first, then #4271, then this PR after `git merge origin/main` and a new gate. Per AGENTS.md, two sides that changed the same logic are resolved with care, not by a guess.
2. **No before/after screenshots.** The PR changes `crates/ui` (`tool_library_dialog/stack.rs`, `stack_view.rs`): the stack values row and the "Swap <part>…" menus are new. Add a before and an after screenshot of the component stack group to the PR body: an applied stack with its values, a draft with the "(from the stack edits; not applied)" note, and an open swap menu. Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them. Do not commit them to the PR branch.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The swap keeps the `port` of each later row. If the new part names its ports differently, the resolver refuses the stack, and the part is not in the list. That is safe. A later slice can map the ports, so that such a part is offered too.
- `stack_view::view` makes a new key (a copy of the name and the links) on each frame to compare with the cache. The cost is small. It is not a frame-cost defect.

A collaborator merges this PR at the next cut, after the parents merge and this PR is refreshed and reviewed again.
